In this video, my journey through Chile takes an unexpected turn as I have to go to court to deal with a ₹25,000 speeding fine.
While driving through Chile, I was caught doing around 102 km/h in an 80 km/h speed zone. Unlike simply paying a traffic fine on the spot, I had to deal with the local process and eventually visit the court to settle the fine.
Getting a traffic ticket in your own country is one thing, but dealing with police, rules and a court system in a foreign country where you’re travelling is a completely different experience.
